summary: Watched 6 Shorts from 4–11 Nov next to their drop points. Added one new lesson (the ordinary figure before the big one) and raised three existing lessons with new evidence.
why: Biggest drops all fell on the second beat at 5.0–5.3 s (Magic Johnson −29% on '$40M' before '$1.6B', The Line −21%, the gym −25%), and the two hooks that named nobody lost 27% and 13% in the first 1.4 s against 10% for the one that named Magic Johnson.
